reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) discusses general phase prediction using pairwise interactions and mechanical properties of 3d transition metal HEAs, but provides no specific data on Al diffusion kinetics, its sluggishness, or its role in suppressing phase separation in the Cr–Co–Fe–Ni–Al system. The key premises about Al-controlled kinetic suppression and transformation behavior are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
